verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect's own testing docs describe testing the integration before going live, covering account creation, identity verification and payouts. That implies a pre-production test environment, but the pack never explicitly describes a sandbox or test mode isolated from live data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an isolated sandbox/test mode separate from production data, details on test keys or test accounts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Before going live, test your Connect integration for account creation, identity verification, and payouts.
